title: GitHub Trending Summary - Daily - 2026-11-12
ranking_basis: Daily GitHub Trending star gains for nine entries; two recent-creation additions appended without comparable daily gain data.
ranking_explanation: The nine eligible repositories from the daily Trending page are ordered by their displayed stars-today values, descending. The community-maintained fork was filtered out. Two repositories verified through GitHub Search and repository metadata as created in the preceding 48 hours are appended as unranked recent additions.
global_caveat: Trending gains are a point-in-time website signal; total stars and default-branch commits were checked through the GitHub REST API. Recent additions have lifetime star counts only, not daily gains. No prior-window evidence was collected.

sections.title: Snapshot
sections.content: Snapshot time: 2026-11-12 01:38 UTC. Scope: Daily. Date range: 2026-11-11 through 2026-11-12 UTC, GitHub daily Trending view. Ranking basis: daily Trending star gains for nine repositories, plus two recently created repositories appended as unranked additions.

sections.title: Headline
sections.content: Meta's Astryx is the runaway daily signal at 2,776 stars, while agent-oriented developer tooling—engineering skills, browser control, and code auditing—anchors the rest of the list. Two very new projects add a robotics world-model and private meeting-notes angle, but their lifetime star counts are not comparable to Trending's daily gains.

sections.title: meta/astryx
sections.description: An open design system for React that emphasizes deep customization and workflows shared by developers and coding agents.
sections.why_notable: The strongest daily gain by a wide margin; its README describes 150+ accessible components, themes, a CLI, and a beta built on React 19 and StyleX.
sections.unique_caveat: The README labels the project beta.

sections.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
sections.description: Engineering workflows and reusable skills for AI coding agents.
sections.why_notable: A major agent-tooling signal, packaging a spec-to-ship development lifecycle into commands and skills for multiple coding agents.
sections.unique_caveat: The README notes that installing an individual skill may omit shared repository-level reference files.

sections.title: vercel-labs/agent-browser
sections.description: A browser automation CLI designed for AI agents.
sections.why_notable: Strong momentum for command-line, accessibility-tree-based browser control; the README documents a persistent browser daemon and ref-based interaction loop.
sections.unique_caveat: The README's initial setup downloads Chrome for Testing unless an alternate supported browser mode is configured.

sections.title: homeassistant-ai/ha-mcp
sections.description: Configure and automate Home Assistant with AI assistants.
sections.why_notable: Shows agent tooling moving into smart-home operations through a Model Context Protocol integration.

sections.title: shadcn/improve
sections.description: Uses a capable model to audit a codebase and produce plans for cheaper models to execute.
sections.why_notable: A distinct agent workflow pattern: separate high-reasoning review and planning from lower-cost implementation.

sections.title: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis
sections.description: An LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with market data, news, dashboards, and notifications.
sections.why_notable: A high-visibility domain-specific AI application combining financial data ingestion, analysis, and scheduled delivery.

sections.title: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src
sections.description: Source for Modern Web Guidance, a set of skills embedding web-platform expertise and browser-compatibility data into coding agents.
sections.why_notable: A browser-vendor-backed web platform resource is gaining attention alongside the agent-focused projects.

sections.title: openai/codex-security
sections.description: Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing vulnerabilities.
sections.why_notable: Extends coding-agent workflows into scanning, validating findings, generating patches, and CI or SDK automation.
sections.unique_caveat: The README states that some cybersecurity requests and protected findings require Trusted Access for Cyber.

sections.title: TheAlgorithms/Java
sections.why_notable: A conventional educational/reference repository provides a non-agent counterpoint in the daily list.

sections.title: HybridRobotics/supermimic
sections.description: Humanoid whole-body motion tracking trained with a differentiable world model.
sections.why_notable: Newly created within the preceding 48 hours and prominent in recent-creation Search results; its README links a project page and paper and provides training and playback workflows.
sections.unique_caveat: The README's setup requires a sibling mjlab_research checkout, and its training command expects a GPU identifier.

sections.title: FrigadeHQ/yogurt
sections.description: An open-source desktop app for private AI meeting notes that records without adding a meeting bot.
sections.why_notable: Newly created within the preceding 48 hours and a fresh example of AI features packaged as a cross-platform desktop product.
sections.unique_caveat: The README lists platform requirements including 8 GB memory, and macOS support is limited to Apple Silicon.

sections.title: Trending Technologies and Themes
sections.content: Agent-oriented developer tools: Astryx, agent-skills, agent-browser, improve, and Codex Security cover agent-ready UI components, reusable engineering workflows, browser actions, delegated coding plans, and security remediation. AI moving into operational domains: ha-mcp applies assistants to home automation, while daily_stock_analysis targets market research and Yogurt packages meeting notes as a desktop app. Physical AI and robotics: SuperMimic is a fresh robotics project using a differentiable world model for humanoid motion tracking. Languages: TypeScript appears in four repositories; Python in three; JavaScript, Rust, and Java appear once each; one repository has no primary language listed by GitHub.

sections.title: Takeaway
sections.content: The strongest daily signal is not a single model release but the spread of agent-facing software into the tools people already use: design systems, engineering workflows, browsers, security, home automation, and finance. The two recent additions broaden that picture into robotics and private desktop AI, though their reported lifetime stars should not be read as daily gains.

sections.title: Sources and Method
sections.content: Primary source: https://github.com/trending?since=daily. Corroboration: GitHub REST repository metadata and default-branch commit endpoints for listed repositories; GitHub Search API query created:>=2026-11-10 stars:>100 sorted by stars for recent additions. Nine eligible entries are ordered by daily Trending displayed gains; two repositories created in the preceding 48 hours are appended without daily gain claims. A community-maintained fork was omitted. No prior-window comparison was collected.
